page.overview:
Who is Beef?

Beef is one of the members of the Best Fitness Friends, and a major antagonist in Bowser Jr.'s Journey.

Beef appears as a blobby pink creature wearing black karate shorts, black wristbands, and a red karate belt. His red hair is tied back in a

Bowser Jr.'s Journey profile: "The brute force of the BFF. He's silent, but just one attack will leave you reeling."

Beef makes a brief cameo appearance in the main story. When Bowser accidentally detonated the storage of Bob-ombs after using a treadmill to burn off his fat from eating gallons of food as a trick deployed by Fawful, Beef can be seen unconscious, within the crates of Bob-ombs, and was presumably freed from that experience afterwards.
